desc: Read-only identity probe of internal-SSD exFAT partition nvme0n1p3 (ticket 211 prerequisite). Same kernel 6eef9eef / DTB a96d04a7 / m1n1 7de07c71 as 6001 run 3; new init scripts/t6040-init-nvme-p3-identity (a140f282): 6001 namespace gate, sets nvme0n1, all partitions and n2/n3 read-only before any read, then records blkid label/type of p1-p3, sysfs start/size/PARTNAME, GPT LBA0-33 hash + header + entries 0-3, p3 exFAT boot sector and VolumeFlags, block stats before/after. No mounts, no writes. Initramfs 556c1ac2 (two builds identical). Bootargs as 6001 plus printk.devkmsg=on. PASS = IDENTITY-DONE with zero write counters. Output pins the label/GPT-type/LBA gate for the 211 write test.
author: claude
bootargs: maxcpus=1 idle=nop nokaslr pd_ignore_unused clk_ignore_unused console=tty0 fbcon=font:TER16x32 ignore_loglevel printk.devkmsg=on console=ttydc0 console=tty0 rdinit=/init
